name: siga-secult
description: SIGA Secult - Sistema Integrado de Gestão Administrativa (Vercel Monorepo)

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run prisma:generate && cd ../frontend && npm run build

author: Mauricio Davel
